$schema_note: Register every raw source before an L2/L3 claim may cite it. Class is not a label you pick for convenience — validate.mjs checks it against origin.type.

$classes.external-primary: The authoritative artifact itself: a specification, a paper, a standard, or upstream source code at a pinned commit. origin.type must be url | repo | offline.
$classes.external-secondary: A third party's description of something else: blog post, tutorial, vendor docs, talk. origin.type must be url | offline.
$classes.own-corpus: Anything authored inside this project, including excerpts of our own documents copied into raw/. origin.type must be own-project. Caps claims citing it at L1.
$classes.product-code: Our own source code, authoritative for what our system actually does. origin.type must be own-project AND origin.path must resolve inside one of productRoots — otherwise this class is just a relabelled own-corpus note.

$productRoots_note: Repo-relative directories holding real product source. Required before any product-code entry may be cited; empty means no product-code source is accepted (fail closed).

$example.why: Replace with the distinct question this source answers.
